calculation.description: Reverses the completed session return, weighting abnormal-volume sessions and attenuating candles whose body consumes the full daily range. All inputs are known at the signal cutoff; zero ranges are treated as missing.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (+0.097409, 690 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.075191, 459 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.026865, 531 dates). Cross-sectional observations used at least 8 of 15 tradable instruments; small-universe uncertainty, selective volume coverage, high turnover, and likely redundancy with the existing volume-weighted intraday reversal require correlation review.
